CustomField.description: Id (as text) of the step that must complete before this one activates. Null means this step opens immediately when the chain starts. A plain Text field rather than a real self-lookup - mirrors the same pattern already used for Task.Parent_Task__c/Waiting_On_Task__c on the Activity object, chosen after a genuine self-referencing Lookup field on this object exhibited unreliable cross-transaction write visibility in this org.
CustomField.label: Depends On Step
